title: Device-Associated (DA) Module Data Summary Reports | NHSN | CDC
content: Device-Associated (DA) Module Data Summary Reports Print Minus Related Pages These reports present a summary of data reported to NHSN’s Device-Associated (DA) Module through 2013, and include location-stratified infection rates and device utilization. DA Module data after 2013 are included in the HAI Progress Reports .
